title: Mathership Captive Catalog, Memory, Cultural-Object and Experiment Collection Graph
scope: Classify all 25 alien captive recorded logs by what type of information/specimen they expose, test the hypothesis that Mothership Zeta functions partly as a catalog/archive/collection system, and use that model to evaluate why Earth cultural objects such as party hats or Giddyup Buttercup are aboard the ship.

recording_system.protocol_observation: Multiple captives are compelled to identify themselves or speak into an alien recording device; Dr. Morrison Rand says abductees do this before suspended animation.
recording_system.Rand_interpretation: The protocol resembles creating library catalog entries before placement into a giant collection.

why_Lone_Wanderer_needed.stronger_interpretation: The Lone Wanderer enters an already-existing long-duration collection/experimentation system rather than being the reason that system exists.
why_Lone_Wanderer_needed.exceptionality: Their later success in escape/uprising is outcome evidence, not proof they were uniquely selected beforehand.
